# receipt-parser

> Parse receipts from OCR text with rules, no model: merchant, date, line items with quantities, subtotal, tax and total in Decimal, OCR digit fixes and consistency checks Python package `trysac-receipt-parser`, import name `receipt_parser`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
